head: Band·je Mac dictation app also transcribes calls on the device
dek: Band·je types what you say into any app on a Mac and records and transcribes Zoom, Teams, Meet, FaceTime and phone calls without a bot joining, with all processing on the device. Recording is free and the first 5 transcriptions are free; after that it's a one-time payment.
details: Band·je Unlimited costs 19.99 euros once for all your devices, or 9.99 euros in a Black Friday offer until 1 December. It works in 25 European languages, labels who said what, and writes summaries from your own templates. The Mac app needs macOS 15 and Apple silicon; there are also iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch apps, and iCloud sync is optional and off by default. Its maker, Neurendal, publishes the code under the GPL license.
where: Mac with Apple silicon (macOS 15), iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch
means: If you dictate a lot or need notes from calls, Band·je does it without sending your audio to the cloud or paying a subscription.
todo: Try the 5 free transcriptions first; the Black Friday price runs until 1 December.
